visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit indoor living room with light wood floors and white walls, a young girl with pigtails wearing a red t-shirt with a watermelon design and striped pink shorts stands facing an adult woman. The woman, seen from the back or partially, has black hair tied in a bun with a green clip and wears a white and black patterned sweater. The girl covers her eyes with her small hands as if playing hide-and-seek. (2) The adult woman shows her empty hands to the child. The child laughs and smiles broadly, showing her teeth. A shelf filled with colorful toys, books, and bins is visible in the background against the left wall. A large white air purifier and a bean bag chair are also present in the setting. (3) The child covers her eyes again while the adult prepares a surprise. The lighting is natural and bright from a nearby window. (4) The child walks into a hallway where a tall man with long hair tied back and a younger child in a purple shirt are standing. The man wears a tan t-shirt and black shorts. (5) Back in the main room, the girl covers her eyes once more. The adult woman places a plush octopus toy on her lap. The child uncovers her eyes and reacts with excitement and joy. (6) A final pink graphic screen appears featuring a cartoon version of the little girl and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
